# iosxe_voice_class_tls_cipher (Data Source)

This data source can read the Voice Class TLS Cipher configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_voice_class_tls_cipher" "example" {
  tag = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class srtp-crypto tag

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `ciphers` (Attributes List) TLS cipher-suite (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ciphers))
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.

<a id="nestedatt--ciphers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ciphers`

Read-Only:

- `cipher_suite` (String)
- `preference` (Number) Set the preference order for the cipher-suite (1 = Highest)
